name: fault-lines
notes: Faulted stone as a dual-gated triple: 72 half-plane faults at full step (solid polygonal facets) with subtle ridge lines along the traces, fbm floor at 0.12. Converged from four variants: pure facets collapse into one mass at cut time, heavy lines read as streaks, 48 was bolder but poorer in angular vocabulary; canvas anchoring was considered and rejected in review - all these ship dual-gated. Levels 30/55/80 = light/medium/heavy, calibrated to core-band stroke coverage by tools/fractal-tip.mjs --calibrate; verified by tools/spectrum-audit.mjs.
